name: code-reviewer
description: Reviews a repository read-only and explains it in plain Korean. Use when the user asks for a code review.

name: research-assistant
description: Researches a topic on the web and writes a sourced Korean brief. Use when the user asks for research.

name: csv-cleaner
description: Removes duplicate rows and trims whitespace in one CSV file. Use when a CSV has messy rows before analysis.

name: korean-proofreader
description: 한국어 문서의 맞춤법과 띄어쓰기를 교정한다. 사용자가 한국어 글의 교정을 요청할 때 사용한다.

name: pdf-summarizer
description: Summarizes a single PDF document into a Korean one-page brief. Use when the user hands over a PDF and asks for a summary.
